title: Maximizer Enrollment Status and the Program's Draw on a Fill — Specialty Pharmacy Program Member Terms
content:
**Clause.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, how the manufacturer program draws on a fill depends on whether the member has enrolled in the maximizer.

- When the member is enrolled in the maximizer, the draw is the lesser of two amounts: the fill's unpaid remainder less the maximizer member cost share, and the even draw.
- When the member is not enrolled, and no more than the maximizer enrollment deadline has passed since activation, no draw is made yet, because the member's choice is still open.
- Otherwise the draw is the lesser of the fill's unpaid remainder and the whole benefit available, without spreading it.

A member enrolled in the maximizer is charged the maximizer member cost share on the part of a fill's cost share that the even draw covers. The part of the fill's cost share above the even draw stays owed by the member.

## Tier figures

| Tier | Coordination type | Maximizer member cost share per fill | Maximizer enrollment deadline (calendar days after activation) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | standard coordination | $0.00 | 0 (no maximizer) |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | standard coordination | $0.00 | 0 (no maximizer) |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | standard coordination | $0.00 | 0 (no maximizer) |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | variable copay | $0.00 | 0 (no maximizer) |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | variable copay | $0.00 | 0 (no maximizer) |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | maximizer | $0.00 | 30 |

## Reading the records

- Whether the member is enrolled in the maximizer is shown on the therapy's enrollment.
- The time since activation is counted in calendar days from the activation date on the enrollment, which is day zero, through today. "No more than the deadline has passed" includes the deadline day itself.

## Deadline boundary on Northbridge Specialty Total Care (30 days; today assumed to be 2026-10-08; member not enrolled)

| Activation date | Days since activation | Draw |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-10 | 28 | none yet (zero) |
| 2026-09-08 | 30 | none yet (zero) |
| 2026-09-07 | 31 | the lesser of the unpaid remainder and the whole benefit available |

## Enrolled member, worked through (assumed figures on Northbridge Specialty Total Care, member cost share $0.00)

| Unpaid remainder | Even draw | Draw | Left owed by the member |
|---|---|---|---|
| $1,200.00 | $3,000.00 | $1,200.00 | $0.00 |
| $1,200.00 | $800.00 | $800.00 | $400.00, the part above the even draw |
